In `/scratch/lelarge/mathcomp-eulerian/psi_descent_thms.v`, two lemmas fail to compile: `rs_head_max_descent` and `rs_head_min_no_descent`.

The root cause: `rewrite !index_uniq ?Hsz_rs ?ltnW //` causes a timeout because the `!` (repeat) and `?` (try) combinators create an exponential search. This was the original proof pattern from psi_descent.v.

The fix: replace the exponential `rewrite !index_uniq ...` with explicit applications of `index_uniq`.

`index_uniq` has type:
```
forall [T : eqType] (x0 : T) [i : nat] [s : seq T],
  i < size s -> uniq s -> index (nth x0 s i) s = i
```

The goal context at the failing point (in both lemmas) looks like:
```
Hu_rs : uniq (rank_shift_seq L)
Hsz_rs : size (rank_shift_seq L) = size L
H1_lt : 1 < size (rank_shift_seq L)
|- index (nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 0) (rank_shift_seq L) = 
   index (nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1) (rank_shift_seq L) -> False
```

The goal was reached after `move/(f_equal (fun x => index x (rank_shift_seq L)))`.

Use `rocq_start(file="psi_descent_thms.v", theorem="rs_head_max_descent")` to start interactive proving. Navigate to the failing point, fix the proof for that lemma, then do the same for `rs_head_min_no_descent`.

Key constraint: the fixed proof must be FAST (< 1 second for each tactic). Avoid any `rewrite !` patterns.

After fixing both proofs, write the changes to the file and verify with `rocq_compile`.

269	   v > nth 0 (sort leq L) (size L).-1) ->
270	  (nth 0 L j > v) = (nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) j' > v).

279	  have [_ Hmax_j'] := elem_rs_in_range Hj'.

305	(* The descent-set effect of psi_i, organized by tree case (R vs LR) and     *)

308	(* Justification: M4_DESCENT_EFFECT_INFORMAL.md sections 2-4.                *)

310	(* ----- Common proof pattern for descent-effect lemmas ---------------------- *)
311	(* Each lemma case-splits k relative to window [i, i+ws):                     *)
312	(*   k+1 < i (prefix), k = i-1 (left boundary), k = i (head),               *)
313	(*   i < k < i+ws (interior), k = i+ws-1 (right boundary), k >= i+ws (suffix)*)
314	
315	(* Factored helpers: interior and right-boundary cases are identical across   *)
316	(* all four descent-effect lemmas. Extracting them avoids quadrupling the     *)
317	(* proof term and cuts ~60 GB peak memory to ~15-20 GB.                      *)
318	
319	Lemma descent_psi_interior i w k :
320	  uniq w -> 1 < window_size i w ->
321	  i < k -> k.+1 < i + window_size i w ->
322	  is_descent_seq (psi i w) k = is_descent_seq w k.
323	Proof.
324	move=> Hu Hws Hk_gt Hk1_in.
325	have Hiw := ws_lt_size Hws.
326	have Hk_lt : k < i + window_size i w :=
327	  ltn_trans (ltnSn k) Hk1_in.
328	rewrite /is_descent_seq.
329	rewrite (nth_psi_inside Hiw (ltnW Hk_gt) Hk_lt)
330	        (nth_psi_inside Hiw
331	          (ltnW (ltn_trans Hk_gt (ltnSn k)))
332	          Hk1_in).
333	set L := window_at i w.
334	rewrite -rank_shift_preserves_interior_order //.
335	- congr (_ < _).
336	  + have Hk1_off : k.+1 - i < window_size i w
337	      by rewrite ltn_subLR // ltnW.
338	    by rewrite (nth_window_at Hiw Hk1_off)
339	       subnKC // ltnW.
340	  + have Hk_off : k - i < window_size i w
341	      by rewrite ltn_subLR.
342	    by rewrite (nth_window_at Hiw Hk_off)
343	       subnKC.
344	- by exact: window_head_extremum.
345	- by rewrite subn_gt0.
346	- by rewrite subn_gt0
347	     (ltn_trans Hk_gt (ltnSn k)).
348	- by rewrite (size_window_at Hiw) ltn_subLR.
349	- by rewrite (size_window_at Hiw) ltn_subLR
350	     // ltnW.
351	Qed.

382	    nth 0 (sort leq L) (size L).-1 <

384	    by move: Hgt; rewrite /L /ws HszL.

386	    (or_intror Hgt')).

394	   at position i-1 is preserved by rank_shift because i-1 is outside

399	  is_descent_seq (psi i w) i.-1 = is_descent_seq w i.-1.

403	set ws := window_size i w. set L := window_at i w.
404	have HszL : size L = ws := size_window_at Hiw.

407	rewrite nth_psi_left //.

409	  by rewrite -[X in X < _]addn0 ltn_add2l ltnW.
410	rewrite (nth_psi_inside Hiw (leqnn i) Hi0_ws)

424	(* Case R (right-child only), i not a descent: D(psi_i w) = D(w) u {i}. *)
425	Lemma descent_psi_R_add i w :
426	  uniq w -> 1 < window_size i w -> ~~ has_left_child i w ->
427	  ~~ is_descent_seq w i ->
428	  forall k, k < (size w).-1 ->
429	    is_descent_seq (psi i w) k = (k == i) || is_descent_seq w k.

431	move=> Hu Hws Hnlc Hnd k Hk.

433	set ws := window_size i w. set L := window_at i w.
434	have HuL := window_at_uniq i Hu.
435	have HszL : size L = ws := size_window_at Hiw.
436	have HszL1 : 1 < size L by rewrite HszL.
437	have Hmin : head 0 L = nth 0 (sort leq L) 0.
438	  case/orP: (window_head_extremum Hu Hws) =>
439	    [/eqP //|/eqP Hmax].
440	  exfalso; apply/negP: Hnd; rewrite negbK.

  head 0 L = nth 0 (sort leq L) (size L).-1 ->
  nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 0 < nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1.

Axiom size_window_at' : forall (i : nat) (w : seq nat), i < size w ->
  size (window_at i w) = window_size i w.
Axiom ws_lt_size' : forall (i : nat) (w : seq nat), 1 < window_size i w -> i < size w.

Lemma descent_psi_R_remove' (i : nat) (w : seq nat) :
  uniq w -> 1 < window_size i w -> ~~ has_left_child i w ->
  is_descent_seq w i ->
  forall k, k < (size w).-1 ->

  nth 0 w k > nth 0 w k.+1.

Proof. by []. Qed.

`nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 0 < nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1`.

The `k == i` branch in `descent_psi_LR_swap2` needs to show `is_descent_seq (psi i w) i = false`, i.e., the new `w[i+1] < w[i]` is false, meaning `w[i] < w[i+1]` (or they're equal but that can't happen for uniq).

After rewrites: `nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 0 < nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1` → this is what we want to show `is_descent_seq = false` = we want `NOT (nth 0 (rs L) 1 < nth 0 (rs L) 0)`.

Wait, `is_descent_seq w k = nth 0 w k > nth 0 w k.+1`. The goal for `k = i` is:
`is_descent_seq (psi i w) i = false`
= `nth 0 (psi i w) i > nth 0 (psi i w) i.+1 = false`
= `nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 0 > nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1 = false`

After `apply/negbTE; rewrite -leqNgt`, the goal becomes `nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1 <= nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 0`.

But `rs_head_min_no_descent` gives `nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 0 < nth 0 (rank_shift_seq L) 1` (i.e., position 0 < position 1), so we need `ltnW` applied to get `<=`.

Wait, `leqNgt : m <= n = ~~ (n < m)` and `ltnNge : m < n = ~~ (n <= m)`.

After `apply/negbTE; rewrite -leqNgt`, we get `~~ (nth 0 (rs L) 0 < nth 0 (rs L) 1)` → no wait.

Let me think: `is_descent_seq w k = (nth 0 w k > nth 0 w k.+1)`. We want this = false.
So goal is: `(nth 0 (rs L) 1 < nth 0 (rs L) 0) = false`.
After `apply/negbTE; rewrite -leqNgt`, goal becomes `nth 0 (rs L) 0 <= nth 0 (rs L) 1`... no.

`apply/negbTE` changes `X = false` to `~~ X` (it takes a hypothesis `~~ X : X = false`). So the goal changes from `X = false` to `~~ X`, i.e. `~~ (nth 0 (rs L) 1 < nth 0 (rs L) 0)`.

`rewrite -leqNgt` changes `~~ (n < m)` to `m <= n`. So goal becomes `nth 0 (rs L) 0 <= nth 0 (rs L) 1`.

`rs_head_min_no_descent HuL HszL1 Hmax` gives `nth 0 (rs L) 0 < nth 0 (rs L) 1`.

So `ltnW` applied to this gives `nth 0 (rs L) 0 <= nth 0 (rs L) 1`.

```coq
  apply/negbTE; rewrite -leqNgt;
  by have := rs_head_min_no_descent HuL HszL1 Hmax;
     rewrite ltnNge negbK
```

`rs_head_min_no_descent HuL HszL1 Hmax : nth 0 (rs L) 0 < nth 0 (rs L) 1`.

`rewrite ltnNge` on the hypothesis changes it to `~~ (nth 0 (rs L) 1 <= nth 0 (rs L) 0)`, which is not helpful.

The correct approach is just `exact: ltnW (rs_head_min_no_descent HuL HszL1 Hmax)` or `by exact: ltnW`.

`rs_head_min_no_descent HuL HszL1 Hmax : nth 0 (rs L) 0 < nth 0 (rs L) 1`.
